title: Arson
grade_or_penalty: Aggravated arson: 2nd degree. Arson: 3rd degree. Failure to control or report a dangerous fire: 4th degree
key_points: Aggravated: purposely starting a fire or explosion that recklessly endangers people, or that targets a building or structure, or for hire.
Arson: purposely starting a fire that recklessly places a building or property of another in danger.
elements: The suspect purposely started a fire or caused an explosion
Arson: the act recklessly placed a building or structure of another (or certain other property) in danger of damage or destruction
Aggravated arson: purposely or knowingly placed another person in danger of death or bodily injury, OR purposely targeted a building or structure, OR other aggravating purposes listed in the statute

subsections.label: a
subsections.text: Aggravated arson: starting a fire or explosion that places a person in danger of death or bodily injury, or purposely targets a structure, or for hire or to collect insurance, among other listed purposes

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: Arson: purposely starting a fire or explosion that recklessly places a building, structure or listed property of another in danger

subsections.label: c
subsections.text: Failure to control or report a dangerous fire the actor knows of and has a duty to address
